framework.description: Research Constitution for GridEngine daily_consolidation and experience layer v3 fusion: fork vs merge rules for living-experience lineages, quality criteria for daily-present observations. Schema-pack governed artifact (research-constitution page_type) directly usable by GridEngine, HealingFactor, and daily_consolidation jobs on stabilization-wave-20260531 drive.

fork_vs_merge_rules.default_policy: merge-first with explicit fork on high-signal divergence. All lineages carry full provenance via manifest.lineage + TypedEdge 'forked_from' / 'merged_into'.
merge_conditions: daily-present observations from parallel swarms show composite coherence lift >= +0.08 (measured by gaps + contradictions + graph connectivity in post-fusion Drive.think)
no unresolved high-severity contradictions between contributing fusion_checkpoints
participating swarms have emitted at least one strengthened_resilience edge into the target living-experience node within the consolidation window
LineageImmuneSystem assess on merged result returns ThreatLevel below CRITICAL
fusion_checkpoint records all parents and the hybrid fusion_method used (Drive.think + synthesis + graph + calibration)
fork_conditions: a daily-present or healing_attempt observation introduces a new high-signal domain or contradiction cluster that would regress coherence of the main lineage by >0.05 if merged
explicit role-swarm directive (via swarm-artifact or Adversary escalation) requests parallel exploration of a regeneration hypothesis
provenance divergence: two candidate daily-presents cite incompatible genome versions or healing outcomes that cannot be reconciled without loss of prediction_power
resilience budget exhaustion on the primary lineage (see constrained evolutionary search constitution) — fork preserves the prior high-performing genome while new branch experiments
fork_vs_merge_rules.lineage_governance: Every fork emits TypedEdge (forked_from, weight=0.9). Every merge emits (merged_into, weight=0.85) + updates the primary living-experience manifest.version and last_improved. GridEngine._maintenance_loop and run_daily_consolidation_job are the only authorized executors. Promotion policy must approve all lineage root changes.
fork_vs_merge_rules.experience_layer_v3_anchor: The canonical 'one-experience' living-experience genome (and its daily-present children) remains the sole prefer_experience_layer boost target. Forks are queryable as siblings but never replace the anchor without full multi-metric validation + role-swarm quorum via Consolidator + Verifier.

mandatory_content: page_type: 'daily-present' (explicit for schema pack resolution + source_boost + expert_routing)
manifest with authors (swarm type), applicability.domains including 'daily-consolidation' and 'experience-layer-v3'
framework.steps capturing the executed sequence (think, synthesize, checkpoint)
full fusion_checkpoint (timestamp, participating_swarms, drive_think_results with gaps/contradictions, graph_signals_summary, calibration_state_snapshot, experience_layer_preference: true)
provenance with full lineage + produced_by referencing DurableJobSupervisor phase='daily_consolidation' + run_daily_consolidation_job
quality_standards: must reference at least the core daily_q Drive.think(prefer_experience_layer=True) + at least 3 family swarm contributions
gaps and contradictions must be explicitly listed (not summarized away); fusion_checkpoint must show net reduction or addressed count
fusion_method must be 'hybrid' and name all primitives (drive.think + synthesis + graph + calibration + schema page_type)
must emit or propose KG edges for role_swarm_coherence_achieved / has_daily_present_entry / fused_from_stabilization
self-referential note: the daily-present itself becomes high-signal input for future daily_consolidation and HealingFactor diagnosis
quality_criteria_for_daily_present_obser.auto_promotion_path: On successful completion of run_daily_consolidation_job, the produced daily_present_genome is submitted via Drive.ingest with page_type resolution (research-constitution + daily-present). SchemaPackManager + promotion policy + LineageImmune provide the gate. On pass: auto-attributed into experience layer v3 as the new authoritative daily Conductor entrypoint.
quality_criteria_for_daily_present_obser.failure_mode: If quality criteria not met, job result still recorded but daily-present is quarantined or demoted to synthesis-artifact. No auto-promotion. Escalation via HealingSignalEvent triggers HealingFactor.

framework.gridengine_integration: GridEngine._maintenance_loop submits daily_consolidation jobs at configured interval. GridConfig.daily_consolidation_interval_s governs cadence. All outputs carry stabilization_wave tag. HealingFactor may trigger ad-hoc consolidation as an experience_consolidation proposal.
framework.self_referential_improvement: This constitution is itself a daily-present style candidate. Gaps discovered during live daily_consolidation executions (e.g. insufficient fork/merge signal) become HealingFactor damage signals.

realtime_living_grid_research_threads.description: Initial Research Constitution for the GridEngine itself as persistent always-on event-driven living Grid (Real-Time Grid Engine Hardening Swarm, stabilization-wave-20260531 drive). Governs continuous autonomous research threads, event bus subscriptions (HealingSignalEvent/Resolved), auto-damage detection (synthesis, posture, reconciliation, healing-damage), auto-dispatch of healing jobs + role-swarm research org threads, full correlation + durable heartbeats/leases, experience layer auto-incorporation of thread outcomes as high-signal observations, and observability surfaces (get_grid_health, list_active_research_threads).

governance_rules.research_thread_formation: Only via GridEngine.form_autonomous_research_thread or _on_healing_signal / _research_thread_coordinator_loop. Always reference this constitution + healingfactor constitution. Roles formed per Multi-Agent Research Org (Diagnoser->Proposer->Verifier->Consolidator->Adversary handoff).
governance_rules.budget_discipline: Every thread carries research_budget (max_iterations, synthesis_calls, time_s). Threads exceeding budget are lease-terminated by DurableJobSupervisor; outcomes still ingested for learning. High-signal only promoted via promotion policy + LineageImmune.
governance_rules.event_reactivity: GridEngine must subscribe to HealingSignalEvent at start() for immediate (non-polling) reactivity. Proactive sweeps in _scan_and_heal_once supplement. All dispatches carry correlation_id.
governance_rules.auto_incorporation: Resolved signals + research thread manifests auto-record into _research_thread_manifests. High-signal (per high_signal_threshold) surface via daily_consolidation as research-thread or daily-present observations. Drive.think(prefer_experience_layer=True) immediately benefits.
governance_rules.heartbeat_lease: All research threads and healing jobs use supervisor lease + explicit renewal threads for durability across restarts. last_heartbeat surfaced in queue metadata and Grid health.
governance_rules.observability: get_grid_health() and list_active_research_threads() are canonical; must be queryable by Conductor, TUI, web observability, and self-diagnostic Drive.think calls.

realtime_living_grid_research_threads.constitution_self_test: Post-GridEngine start + one research thread cycle, Drive.think(prefer_experience_layer=True, max_genomes=5) on 'real-time GridEngine research threads constitution' returns this artifact + prior living-experience v3 with measurable graph signal + resilience edge lift.

framework.coordination_protocol_note: Consolidator role owns daily_consolidation execution and lineage decisions per these rules. Verifier validates quality criteria before promotion. Diagnoser surfaces coherence regressions as healing-damage. Proposer may suggest fork or merge as experience_consolidation proposals.

reasoning_patterns.merge_preference: Merge is the default to protect single-source-of-truth for Conductors; fork is exceptional and always provenance-tracked.
reasoning_patterns.coherence_first: Any daily-present that would decrease experience layer v3 coherence is rejected for merge regardless of other signals.
